𝐅𝐑𝐄𝐄 𝐅𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐒𝐇𝐎𝐑𝐓 𝐌𝐎𝐕𝐈𝐄⁣
⁣
This is one of the best short movies about 9/11. Very underrated and you can watch it for free online.⁣
⁣
Inspired by a true story told by Dutch investigative journalist Joris Luyendijk in his book “Swimming with Sharks”, this movie takes place on the morning of September 11, 2001. While millions of people around the world watched the attacks unfold in horror, one young trader at a London investment bank saw something completely different: an opportunity. Although the film is fictionalized, it is based on an anonymous account shared with Luyendijk by a real investment banker during his research into London’s financial world.⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
While thousands of innocent people were fighting for their lives inside the World Trade Center, others were making fortunes from the disaster. Imagine the emotional conflict. On one side, you have the greatest financial success of your life. On the other, you are watching one of history’s darkest moments unfold live on television.⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
What makes 𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐥𝐥 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟏) so powerful is that it never portrays its protagonist as a villain. He is simply a product of the environment he works in. Traders are trained to react faster than everyone else and to profit from uncertainty. On September 11, those instincts collided with one of the most horrible acts of the twenty-first century.
